format: UCWDC Finals, first and second tiebreakers

source.quote_free_summary: Tied contestants are separated first by majority size (count of marks right of the majority mark with a larger value; smaller is better) then by majority sum (total of marks left of the majority mark; smaller is better).

requirement: A UCWDC engine must apply Rule #4 then Rule #5 in order.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A blocker to activating any future UCWDC scoring profile (OD-13). A future UCWDC engine must be independently verified, separately versioned (never by editing ordinal_rank@1 or studio_ordinal_majority@1) and evaluated under OD-24. Docs-only record: no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Studio chain step (2) sums ordinals at or below the cutoff, which is not the same quantity as Rule #5; no equivalence claimed.
decision_refs: OD-13 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve DanceFlow Studio scoring; retrospective audit PR #795)
